slides.headline: You Canceled. The Fitness App Kept Charging.
slides.subheadline: A cancellation confirmation is evidence—not the end of checking.

items.label: Genesis Tech
items.body: Charges or attempted charges continued after cancellation, FTC alleged.

items.label: Its Apps
items.body: Offerings included MadMuscles, Harna and Unimeal.

slides.visualStyle: Monumental investigative cover; oversized typography and a broken payment loop.

slides.headline: The Trial Became A Bigger Bill
slides.subheadline: Noom customers challenged trial messaging, automatic enrollment and difficult exits.

items.label: Upfront Charge
items.body: Complaint coverage described up to $199.99 for six months, non-refundable.

items.label: Unused Service
items.body: The complaint alleged conversion even without accessing or downloading.

slides.visualStyle: Documentary still life; a quiet phone beside an outsized billing receipt.

layout.hero: Wide central illustration with generous negative space.
layout.items: Two equal columns beneath the illustration.

slides.headline: One-Time Offer. Recurring Payments.
slides.subheadline: The FTC alleged Genesis Tech buried the continuing payment commitment.

items.label: Prominent Promise
items.body: Free or low, one-time-cost offers drew customers in.

items.label: Smallest Print
items.body: Recurring-payment terms appeared in the smallest print, the FTC alleged.

slides.visualStyle: Typographic contrast study; loud offer shapes versus nearly invisible billing lines.

layout.headline: Across the top.
layout.items: One caption directly beneath each corresponding panel.

slides.headline: Easy In. Hard Out.
slides.subheadline: The FTC alleged Genesis Tech put obstacles between customers and cancellation.

items.label: Missing Controls
items.body: Cancellation controls were missing, the FTC alleged.

items.label: Required Explanations
items.body: Customers had to explain why they wanted to cancel.

slides.visualStyle: Technical escape diagram; a direct entrance feeds an obstructed return path.

layout.hero: Large diagonal path running from upper right to lower left.

slides.headline: Small Purchases Can Become Long Commitments
slides.subheadline: Beachbody’s permanent court order required safeguards around joining and leaving.

items.label: Before Billing
items.body: Clear renewal terms, separate consent, and a post-payment summary.

items.label: After Joining
items.body: Easy online/phone exits; reminders for plans 6 months or longer.

slides.visualStyle: Architectural boundary diagram; explicit gates around a recurring-payment loop.

slides.subheadline: The FTC’s Genesis Tech allegations remained for the court to decide.

items.label: Genesis Tech
items.body: FTC announced a temporary court halt on June 17, 2026.

slides.headline: Cancel. Save Proof. Check Again.
slides.subheadline: Follow exit instructions. Save requests and chats. Check statements.

items.label: Dispute Charges
items.body: Contact your card issuer online or by phone; follow up in writing.

items.label: Report Subscriptions
items.body: Report: ReportFraud.ftc.gov or your state attorney general.
